messages:
incident-bot: Pager: error_budget_burn spike on inference-prod - 5xx rate >20% in us-east-1. Paging oncall.

sre-oncall: Oncall here — taking it. ETA to investigate 5m.

maya: Saw alerts too, routing traffic away via traffic-engineer. Are embeddings affected?

devon: I can lift a canary to 2 nodes, trying now.

sre-oncall: Running rollback to model-v2-quant; command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/runner --to-revision=3`

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2. Affected customers with SLA tokens: acme-inc, brightmetrics. Notified #customer-impact.

anya: :eyes: I'll DM ACME support and prepare impact blurb.

olivia: Can we get gateway logs? saw `ERROR: KV cache invalidation timeout` in sample.

devon: Logs show a cache-miss storm and downstream 429 retries. Temporarily increasing cache TTL and reducing write-through.

sre-oncall: Mitigation applied: bumped cache TTL, rolled back model. Observability: 5xx rate down to ~3% over the last 2m.

maya: :thumbsup: Confirming customer errors trending down. Marking incident as mitigated and removing paging.

incident-bot: Paging resolved. Bridge closed. Please schedule a post-incident review within 72h and assign RCA owner.

devon: I'll own the RCA writeup and timeline. Will draft contributing factors and short-term/long-term fixes.

anya: Assigning action items now: 1) add circuit-breaker at gateway (#1234) 2) surface cache miss metrics (#1235) 3) run targeted load test on model-v2 variants (#1236). I'll create tickets and link them.

olivia: Can someone put a calendar invite for postmortem Thurs 10:00 AM PT?

devon: Draft posted: https://redwood-internal/notes/1769533210-rca-draft — includes timeline bullets, logs, mitigation steps. Please review.

maya: Peer review: I'll take a pass and add comments by EOD.

anya: Legal asked for an impact summary for ACME before final sign-off, please include a one-paragraph customer-facing note.

devon: Requesting sign-off from SRE and Product after peer review — @maya @olivia please ack when done.

maya: :white_check_mark: Reviewed. Added expanded timeline and test evidence (log snippets and perf graphs).

olivia: :white_check_mark: Product acked the impact summary. Sign-off complete.

devon: RCA finalized and uploaded to /postmortems/1769533210-inference-cache-miss. Actions created and assigned to tickets #1234 #1235 #1236. Closing loop.

incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: Thu 10:00 AM PT. RCA status: signed-off. Action items created. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation.
